domain.description: The domain or IP address people open, lowercase and without https://.

config.description: Fluxer settings, with the same keys as fluxer.env.

existingSecret.description: A Secret whose keys become settings.

externalSecret.description: A Secret with the connection URL of your own PostgreSQL. Empty runs PostgreSQL in the pod.

maintenance.description: Starts the pod without Fluxer, for fluxerd restore.

mode.description: proxy serves plain HTTP on 8080 behind an Ingress or HTTPRoute. bundled serves 80 and 443 on a LoadBalancer with its own certificate. Empty picks bundled for an IP address with ingress.enabled or httpRoute.enabled on, and proxy otherwise.

expose.description: In bundled mode, loadBalancer puts 80 and 443 on a LoadBalancer Service and hostPort opens them on the node.

mode.description: bundled runs LiveKit in the pod, external uses LiveKit servers added in the admin panel, off turns voice off.

expose.description: hostPort opens the voice ports on the node, which Pod Security baseline and restricted refuse. Use loadBalancer in such a namespace.
